Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following statements are true about India? Use the code given below to select the correct answer:2 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  India → 7th largest by area (after Russia, Canada, USA, China, Brazil, Australia); about 2.4% of world land area; IST meridian 82°30'E; not wholly in the torrid zone. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Six bigger countries: 'RCU-CBA' = Russia, Canada, USA, China, Brazil, Australia; India is 7th.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Tropic of Cancer is passes through which State?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tropic of Cancer → 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram; before 2000 that stretch was in Bihar (now Jharkhand); not Odisha, UP, Meghalaya. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid West to east: 'GRaM ChhaJ WaT Mizo' = Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following towns is nearest to the Tropic of Cancer:Gandhinagar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Town nearest the Tropic of Cancer (23°30'N) → Gandhinagar (23°19'N, only 11' away); Agartala (23°50'N) is 20' away; Jabalpur and Ujjain farther. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following Indian states lies north of the Tropic of Cancer?Manipur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Manipur lies wholly north of the Tropic of Cancer; the Tropic crosses Jharkhand, Mizoram and Tripura. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Standard Indian Time (Meridian Longitude 82° 30') passes through which of the following towns?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Standard Meridian 82°30'E → passes Mirzapur district (near Prayagraj), UP; IST = GMT + 5 hours 30 minutes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Don't pick Allahabad/Prayagraj: the meridian passes Mirzapur district nearby. The book gives no single answer (*).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The southernmost point of India is-Indira Point

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Southernmost point of India → Indira Point, Great Nicobar (Nicobar district, A&N Islands); mainland's southernmost point → Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu (8°4'N). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Indira Point (south, Great Nicobar) with the northernmost point near Siachen Glacier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following states does not form the border with Bangladesh?Manipur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  States bordering Bangladesh → West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram; not Manipur (borders Myanmar) or Nagaland. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid 'MATM + WB': Meghalaya, Assam, Tripura, Mizoram and West Bengal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following groups of Indian states share its boundaries with Pakistan?Punjab, Jammu and Kashmir, Rajasthan and Gujarat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  States/UTs bordering Pakistan → Ladakh, Jammu and Kashmir, Punjab, Rajasthan, Gujarat; not Himachal Pradesh or Haryana. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What is the Radcliffe line?Indo-Pakistan boundary line

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Radcliffe Line → India–Pakistan (and India–Bangladesh) boundary; Durand Line → boundary with Afghanistan. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Radcliffe (Pakistan) with Durand (Afghanistan) or McMahon (China).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The McMahon line demarcates the boundary between which of the following options:Arunachal Pradesh and China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  McMahon Line (Simla Convention, 3 July 1914) → boundary between Arunachal Pradesh and south-eastern China. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The paleomagnetic results obtained from India indicate that in the past, the Indian land mass has moved:Northward

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Paleomagnetic results (record of Earth's magnetic field in rocks) → the Indian landmass has moved northward. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Himalayas are still rising (about 5 mm a year) because the Indian plate is colliding with the Eurasian plate → A and R true; R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements regarding 'Atal Tunnel' Which of them is / are correct?All 1, 2, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Atal Tunnel (Rohtang, 9.02 km) → built by BRO across the Pir Panjal range; links Manali and Lahaul-Spiti; cuts Manali–Leh distance by 46 km; strategic. All four correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • With reference to ‘Atal Tunnel’ which of the following statements is / are correct?Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Atal Tunnel (9.02 km) → Eastern Pir Panjal range; world's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet, but not the longest overall (Norway's Laerdal Tunnel, 24.51 km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Between which two mountain ranges is the Valley of Kashmir situated?Great Himalayas and Pir Panjal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Kashmir Valley → between the Pir Panjal (south-west) and the Great Himalaya/Himadri (north-east). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following is the oldest mountain range in India?Aravalli

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Oldest mountain range of India → Aravalli (Rajasthan); Precambrian fold range, about 570 million years old; highest peak Guru Shikhar (1722 m). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following is the highest peak in South India?Anaimudi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest peak of South India/Peninsula → Anaimudi (2,695 m), Western Ghats, Idukki–Ernakulam, Kerala. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Nilgiri Hills are located between which of these two ranges?Sahyadris (Western Ghats) and Eastern Ghats

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Nilgiri Hills → between and joining the Sahyadri (Western Ghats) and Eastern Ghats; Doddabetta peak is in the Nilgiris. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following lies at the junction of Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu states?Nilgiri Hills

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Nilgiri Hills → part of the Western Ghats at the junction of Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu (mainly Tamil Nadu). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Cardamom Hills lie along the border of the states of –Kerala and Tamil Nadu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Cardamom Hills (Western Ghats) → Kerala–Tamil Nadu border (south-east Kerala, south-west Tamil Nadu); named after cardamom grown there. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Highest mountain peak in India is–K2 Godwin Austin

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest peak of India → K2 (Godwin Austin), Karakoram range, Ladakh; 8611 m; world's second highest. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Highest mountain peak in India –Kanchenjunga

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Everest 8848 m (Nepal–Tibet) > K2/Godwin Austin 8611 m (India) > Kanchenjunga 8598 m (Sikkim–Nepal) > Makalu 8463 m (Nepal). Without K2 in options → Kanchenjunga. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse If K2 is an option it is India's highest; Kanchenjunga wins only when K2 is missing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Match List - I with List - II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists.4 3 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Highest peaks: Tamil Nadu → Doddabetta; Rajasthan → Guru Shikhar; Nagaland → Saramati; Madhya Pradesh → Dhupgarh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Kullu Valley is situated between the mountain ranges of:Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Kullu Valley (Himachal Pradesh) → between the Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal ranges. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following is not correctly matched:Lipulekh – Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Wrong pair: Lipulekh–Uttar Pradesh; Lipulekh is on the India–China border in Uttarakhand. Correct: Shipki La → HP; Nathu La → Sikkim; Zojila → Kashmir. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:2 3 4 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Banihal → Jammu and Kashmir; Nathu La → Sikkim; Niti → Uttarakhand (Uttaranchal); Shipki La → Himachal Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following passes is located in Uttarakhand?Lipulekh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lipulekh → Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand; entry to Mansarovar via Kailash. Jelep La and Nathu La → Sikkim; Shipki La → Himachal Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?Nathu La - Arunachal Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Wrong pair: Nathu La–Arunachal Pradesh (it is in Sikkim). Correct: Lipulekh → Uttarakhand; Rohtang → Himachal Pradesh; Palghat → Kerala. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Chaurabari Glacier is located towards –North of Kedarnath temple

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Chaurabari Glacier (Garhwal, Uttarakhand) → north of Kedarnath temple; its meltwater forms Gandhi Sarovar lake. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Dandakaranya lies in –Chhattisgarh and Orissa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Dandakaranya (about 89078 sq km) → Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh; about 480 km east–west and 320 km north–south. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What is the total length of coastal line of India?7500 km

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  India's coastline → about 7500 km (7516.6 km; re-verified 2023: 11098.81 km); longest state coastline → Gujarat (1214.7 km; now 2340.62 km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The name of the coast of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh is:Coromandel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Coromandel Coast → coast of Tamil Nadu (and Andhra Pradesh), from the Krishna delta (False Divi Point) to Cape Comorin (Kanyakumari). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • "Saddle peak" the highest peak of Andaman &Nicobar is located in-North Andaman

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saddle Peak (732 m) → highest peak of Andaman & Nicobar, near Diglipur on North Andaman. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ten Degree Channel separates –Andaman from Nicobar Islands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ten Degree Channel (along 10° N, about 150 km wide) → separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following islands of India has a volcanic origin?Barren

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Volcanic island of India → Barren Island (Andaman), the only confirmed active volcano in South Asia. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following is a coral island?Lakshadweep

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Coral island → Lakshadweep (Arabian Sea, south-west of India; capital Kavaratti). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following Indian Island lies between India and Sri Lanka?Rameswaram
