                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • About 30 percent of India's area lies in the three states of:Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Three largest states (nearly 30% of India's 3287469 sq km) → Rajasthan (3,42,239), Madhya Pradesh (3,08,252), Maharashtra (3,07,713 sq km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Big three by area 'R-M-M': Rajasthan, MP, Maharashtra.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Out of the four southern states – Andhra Pradesh Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, which shares boundaries with maximum number of Indian states?Each of Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When asked, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka each bordered the most states. Telangana now borders Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Diwali is a festival of mourning among the –Tharus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tharus (Khatima and Sitarganj in Udham Singh Nagar; Terai of UP and Bihar) → follow Hinduism but observe Diwali as a festival of mourning. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Tharu Tribe" is residing in which of the following states of India?Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tharu tribe → Uttarakhand (largest tribe there), Uttar Pradesh (third, after Gond and Kharwar) and Bihar (third, after Santhal and Gond). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is an important tribe of Dhauladhar Range?Gaddi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Gaddi → main tribe of the Dhauladhar Range (Kangra and Chamba, Himachal Pradesh; also J&K); population about 1.5 lakh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Transhumance is practised by the:Bhotias

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Transhumance (migratory pastoralism) → Bhotias (Mongoloid; hills of Uttarakhand); Bhoksas, Jaunsaris and Tharus are settled farmers. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following is the largest tribe in India?Gond

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Largest tribe of India (Census 2011) → Bhil (17071049); Gond (13256928) is second; Gond was largest when first asked. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Toda Tribe is the inhabitant of:Nilgiri Hills

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Toda tribe (Todi, Tuda) → Nilgiri Hills; claim descent from Aryans; their language is Toda. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    All pairs correct (Census 2011): Bhotia → UP (5196); Khasi → Meghalaya; Santhal → Jharkhand; Toda → Tamil Nadu (2002). The book gives no single answer (*). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following tribes of India practice polyandry? Select the answer from the code given below:3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Polyandry in India → Jaunsari, Khas, Toda, Kota, Bota, Tian, Irawa, Nayar; not Gonds or Nagas. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match List – I with List – II and select the correct answer from the code given below:4 3 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Birhor → Jharkhand; Bhutia → Sikkim; Toda → Tamil Nadu; Sentinelese → Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Where do the people of Jarawa tribe, who were in the news recently, reside?Andaman & Nicobar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Jarawa tribe → South and Middle Andaman (A&N Islands); in the news when a court banned tourists in Jarawa areas. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • River Ganga, after entering Bangladesh is known by which of the following names?Padma

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ganga's main branch in Bangladesh → Padma; joined by the Brahmaputra (called Jamuna there), then the Meghna, flowing into the Bay of Bengal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Jamuna (Brahmaputra in Bangladesh) with the Yamuna of India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match List-I with List-II and choose the correct answer using the codes given below in the lists:2 4 1 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Devprayag → Alaknanda + Bhagirathi; Rudraprayag → Alaknanda + Mandakini; Karnaprayag → Alaknanda + Pindar; Tehri → Bhagirathi + Bhilangna. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers meet atDevprayag

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bhagirathi (from Gangotri glacier near Gaumukh, Uttarkashi) meets Alaknanda at Devprayag → thereafter called the Ganga. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Bhagirathi river originates from –Gomukh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bhagirathi → rises at Gomukh of the Gangotri Glacier, 18 km from Shivalinga Peak. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Answer is Gomukh, not Gangotri or Tapovan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following rivers does not join the river Chambal?Betwa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Betwa → rises in the Vindhya Range, joins the Yamuna near Hamirpur (UP); it does not join the Chambal (Kshipra, Kali Sindh, Parvati do). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The catchment area of river Brahmaputra is –Tibet, Bangladesh, India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Brahmaputra catchment → Tibet (China), Bangladesh, India (and Bhutan); Majuli, world's largest inhabited river island, is formed by it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): The rivers of Western Ghats do not form the delta.Both (A) and (R) are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A and R true, R explains A: Western Ghats' west-flowing rivers form no delta → short, fast courses over hard rocks; east-flowing rivers form deltas. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): While all major rivers of peninsular India flow into the Bay of Bengal, the Narmada and the Tapi flow into the Arabian Sea.Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A and R true, R explains A: Narmada and Tapi flow west to the Arabian Sea as they run in rift valleys; other major peninsular rivers → Bay of Bengal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Narmada river flows to the West, while most other large peninsular rivers flow to the East. why?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Narmada flows west because it occupies a linear rift valley between the Vindhyas and Satpuras; rises near Amarkantak (Maikal range), MP. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): The Narmada forms a delta at its mouth.(A) is false, but (R) is true

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A false, R true: Narmada forms no delta because it flows through a rift valley (fault trough) and deposits no silt. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following rivers does not make delta?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Narmada and Tapi (west-flowing, rift valleys, fast flow, little silt) → form estuaries, not deltas; Tapi does not fall into the Bay of Bengal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Son, Narmada, and Mahanadi originate from –—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Son and Narmada → rise at Amarkantak; Mahanadi → Sihawa Hills, Dhamtari (Chhattisgarh), part of the Maikal Range. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Westward flowing rivers are –(i) and (ii)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    West-flowing → Narmada and Tapti (also Mahi); Rapti is a Ghaghara tributary flowing northwest to southeast. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Rapti (Ghaghara tributary) with Tapti (west-flowing).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following rivers thrice forks into two streams and reunites a few miles further on, thus forming the islands of Srirangapatanam, Sivasamudram, and Srirangam?Cauvery

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Cauvery → forms islands of Srirangapatnam, Sivasamudram, Srirangam; rises in Brahmagiri hills (Talakaveri, Kodagu, Karnataka); flows through Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following rivers of India cuts across all the ranges of the Himalayas?Satluj

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Satluj (Sutlej) → Trans-Himalayan river cutting all Himalayan ranges; rises at Rakas Lake (Tibet), enters HP near Shipki La; Beas joins near Harike (Punjab). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Damodar is a tributary of river –Hooghly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Damodar → tributary of the Hooghly (not directly of the Ganga or Padma). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In which of the following rivers, the upper course contains freshwater but saline water flowing at the lower part?Luni river

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Luni → fresh upper course, saline lower course; rises in Aravalli SW of Ajmer, lost in Rann of Kutch marshes after 511 km; land-bound, never reaches sea. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Of the following rivers, the maximum shifting, of course, has taken place in –Kosi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Kosi → maximum shifting of course among Indian rivers; dangerous floods; seven tributaries, Arun the most important. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In the Uttar Pradesh and the Madhya Pradesh States, the joint "Rajghat River Valley Project" is located onBetwa river

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rajghat River Valley Project (joint UP–MP) → on the Betwa, 22 km from Lalitpur (UP); Rajghat Dam is on the Betwa. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following rivers does not originate in India?Sutlej

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Sutlej → rises outside India at Lake Rakastal (Tibet), enters India via Shipki La (Himachal Pradesh); Beas, Chenab, Ravi rise in India. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched:Bhubaneswar - Mahanadi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bhubaneswar → not on the Mahanadi (lies southwest of it); correct: Ahmedabad–Sabarmati, Lucknow–Gomti, Ujjain–Kshipra. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)
