                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      36 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which waterfall of India is popularly known as Niagara Falls?Chitrakote falls

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Chitrakote falls → 'Niagara Falls of India'; on the Indravati near Jagdalpur, Bastar (Chhattisgarh). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is correctly matched?Kolleru - Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Kolleru → Andhra Pradesh; Lonar → Maharashtra, Nakki → Rajasthan, Pulicat → Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The general direction of flow of summer monsoon in India is –from South West to North East

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Summer (south-west) monsoon → blows from South-West to North-East; retreating monsoon from North-East to South-West; most rain from the south-west monsoon. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and choose the correct answer using the codes given below in the lists:3 2 4 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mango shower → coastal Karnataka (and Kerala); Blossom shower → Kerala; Norwesters → West Bengal; Loo → Punjab to Bihar. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Among the following places which one gets the least rainfall?Leh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Least rainfall → Leh (56.967 mm, 2024); Jaisalmer 451.888 mm, Bikaner 457.611 mm, Cherrapunji 10207 mm. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Given below are two statements, one is labeled as Assertion (A) and other is Reason (R)-Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is correct explanation of (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A and R true, R explains A: Tamil Nadu coast is dry in SW monsoon (parallel to Bay branch; rain shadow of Arabian branch); winter rain from NE monsoon. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Given below are two statements, in which one iflabeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is the correct explanathon of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A and R true, R explains A: most of India is dry in winter as north-east trade winds blow land to sea, carrying little moisture (except Tamil Nadu coast). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following areas of India does not come under the zone of high seismic intensity?Karnataka Plateau

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      India has 4 seismic zones (2, 3, 4, 5) on the BIS map; Karnataka Plateau is not high-intensity, unlike Uttarakhand, Kutch, Himachal Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following soils of India has been formed due to weathering of basaltic lava?Regur Soils

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regur (black) soil → formed by weathering of basaltic lava; also called black cotton soil, tropical black earth or tropical chernozem. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Assertion (A): The Regur soils of the Deccan Trap are black in colour.(A) is true, but (R) is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A true, R false: Deccan Trap Regur is black but poor in humus, nitrogen and phosphorus; rich in alumina, iron, lime, magnesium carbonates, potash; best for cotton. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Assertion (A): Black soils are suitable for cotton cultivation.(A) is true but (R) is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A true, R false: black soil suits cotton because it is clayey, holds moisture long and 'self-ploughs' (cracks when dry), not because of humus. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Lava soils are found in:Malwa plateau

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Lava soil → black soil of western India (Deccan trap); the predominant soil of the Malwa Plateau. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which soil needs little irrigation as it retains soil water?Black

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Black soil → needs little irrigation: high moisture retention; 'self-ploughed' as loose particles fall into its cracks. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Laterite soils is found in:Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Laterite → Maharashtra (south), predominant in the Malabar coastal region; leached by alternate wet and dry seasons, poor in lime, rich in iron and aluminium oxides. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse Laterite is NOT rich in lime.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In India maximum alkali area is found in the State of—Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Largest alkali-affected area (exam key) → Uttar Pradesh (2129.61 sq km in a 2019 atlas); largest saline or salt-affected area → Gujarat. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In which one of the following areas in India, is the problem of soil erosion is critical?Foothill areas of Shivalik ranges

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Critical soil erosion → Shivalik/Western Himalayan foothills, Chambal–Yamuna ravines (most affected: Chambal valley), Chotanagpur Plateau, Maharashtra black soil, arid Haryana–Rajasthan–Gujarat. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Soil erosion can be checked byAfforestation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Soil erosion is checked/prevented by afforestation; also contour tillage and banning shifting cultivation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following trees is not of evergreen forest type?Sal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sal (Shorea robusta) → deciduous, not evergreen; Deodar, Silver fir, Blue pine are evergreen conifers. Teak and Sal → tropical deciduous forests. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match the following –2 4 3 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Teak → Central India; Deodar → high Himalaya; Sundari → Sunderban, West Bengal (littoral/tidal forest); Cinchona → Himalayan Tarai. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I (Mangrove) with List-II (State) and select the correct answer from the codes given below the lists:4 1 5 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mangroves: Achra Ratnagiri → Maharashtra; Coondapur → Karnataka; Pichavaram → Tamil Nadu; Vembanad → Kerala (not Karnataka). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In which of the following states, the percentage of total cropped area under irrigation (2011) is the highest?Haryana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Irrigated share of cropped area 2011: Haryana 83.90% (highest of options), UP 72.76%, MP 28.20%, Maharashtra 16.78%. Variant answer: Punjab (99.6%, 2015-16). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Indira Gandhi Canal has its source at:Harike Barrage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Indira Gandhi Canal → starts at Harike Barrage (Satluj-Beas confluence, Firozpur, Punjab); begun 1958; main canal 649 km; irrigates western Rajasthan. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Harike = meeting point of Satluj and Beas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-Il and choose the correct answer using the codes given below in the lists:4 1 2 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Upper Bari Doab Canal → Ravi; Sirhind Canal → Sutlej; Gurgaon Canal → Yamuna; Indira Gandhi Canal → Sutlej, Ravi, Beas. Gang Canal built 1927. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Bari Doab = land between Beas and Ravi.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is/are the main objectives of Sharda Tributary Command Development Project? Select the correct answer using the code given below:All the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sharda Tributary Command Development Project aims: more farm output, multiple cropping (land-use change), better land management → all three. CADP began December 1974. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hariyali is a new scheme for:Development of wasteland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hariyali scheme (27 January 2003, PM Vajpayee) → wasteland development under watershed management; variant answer: water management. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The beneficiary states of the Sardar Sarovar Project are–Gujarat, Maharashtra. M.P. and Rajasthan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sardar Sarovar Dam (163 m) → Narmada, near Navagam, Gujarat; beneficiary states: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Bhakra Nangal is a joint project of –Haryana, Punjab and Rajasthan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Bhakra Nangal → joint project of Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan; two dams (Bhakra and Nangal) on the Satluj. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is the oldest hydropower station in India?Shivasamudram

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Oldest hydropower plant → Darjeeling, West Bengal (1897); Shivasamudram on Kaveri, Karnataka (1902) is second oldest and the answer among options. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Cauvery River Water Dispute (CRWD) is related to which of the following states?Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala and Puducherry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Cauvery River Water Dispute → Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala and Puducherry. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Three states + one UT share the Cauvery.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Nagarjuna Sagar dam is situated in which state of India?Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Nagarjuna Sagar Dam → on the Krishna; Andhra Pradesh when asked, now on the Telangana-Andhra Pradesh border. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • On which river is the Hirakud Dam constructed?Mahanadi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hirakud Dam → Mahanadi, Odisha, 15 km from Sambalpur; main dam 4801 m long. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The benefits of which one of the following river valley projects are shared by more than one state?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Multi-state projects: Chambal (Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh) and Mayurakshi (West Bengal, Jharkhand); Hirakud → Odisha only; Sharavati → Karnataka only. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Tehri dam is being constructed in Uttarakhand-On Bhagirathi river

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tehri Dam → Bhagirathi (Bhilangana joins at old Tehri), Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand; variant answer 'Bhagirathi and Bhilangana'; for flood storage, hydropower, irrigation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following projects is the joint venture of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka:Telugu Ganga

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Telugu Ganga → joint project of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka (book also lists Maharashtra); Krishna water for drinking in Chennai (Madras). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Idukki → Periyar (Kerala, arch dam); Matatila → Betwa (UP-MP joint); Nagarjuna Sagar → Krishna; Pochampad → Godavari.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Oldest hydropower station → Sidrapong near Darjeeling, West Bengal (1897); second → Shivasamudram on Cauvery, Karnataka (1902). Must know

Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tulbul project is associated with the river -Jhelum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tulbul navigation project → Jhelum, at mouth of Wular Lake, J&K; proposed 1984; Pakistan protested in 1987 under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Baglihar hydropower project, the issue of which was raised by Pakistan before the World Bank, is being constructed by India on –Chenab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Baglihar project → Chenab, Ramban district, Jammu & Kashmir; run-of-the-river; Pakistan raised it before the World Bank. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?Sivasamudram - Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Wrong pair: Sivasamudram — Kerala; it is in Karnataka. Jawahar Sagar → Rajasthan; Nagarjuna Sagar → Andhra Pradesh/Telangana; Gandhi Sagar → Madhya Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Teesta Low Dam Project (TLDP)-III is proposed along the Teesta river. The site of the project lies in:West Bengal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Teesta Low Dam Projects III and IV → West Bengal; earlier Teesta projects I and II → Sikkim (variant answer: Sikkim). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The agro-ecological regions of the country are –20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Agro-ecological regions of India → 20 (National Bureau of Soil Survey); each uniform in physiography, climate, growing period, soil. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The first Agricultural University in the country was set up in the year –1960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        First agricultural university → G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar (as UP Agricultural University), inaugurated by Nehru, 17 November 1960. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Norman Ernest Borlaug who is regarded as the father of the Green Revolution is from which country?United States of America

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Norman Ernest Borlaug, Father of the Green Revolution (world) → USA (born 1914, Cresco, Iowa); developed semi-dwarf wheat in Mexico. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Borlaug worked in Mexico but was from the USA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following crops is the highest beneficiary of the Green Revolution in both production and productivity:Wheat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Highest beneficiary of Green Revolution in production and productivity → Wheat, then rice. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Pink Revolution is associated with –Onion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pink Revolution → Onion; Black → Petroleum (crude oil); Red → Tomato and Meat; Blue → Fisheries; Yellow → Oilseed. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Blue Poultry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Wrong pair: Blue — Poultry; Blue Revolution is fisheries/aquaculture. Golden → Horticulture; White → Milk; Green → Agriculture. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Among the following which one is related to Blue Revolution in India?Pisciculture

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Blue Revolution in India → Pisciculture (fish production). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Pisciculture (fish) with Sericulture, Floriculture or Horticulture.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In which months is the Rabi crop sown?October-November

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rabi crops → sown October-November (e.g. mustard, masoor); Kharif crops → sown June-July with first rains, harvested October-November. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following sequence is correct in the context of the three largest wheat producing states?Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Haryana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Top three wheat states when asked: Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana. In 2024-25: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Recent data puts Madhya Pradesh second; Uttar Pradesh stays first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is a disease of the wheat crop:Rust

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Wheat disease → Rust (Yellow, Brown and Black rust). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is a Kharif Crop?Soyabean

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Soyabean → Kharif; Lentil, Linseed, Mustard, Gram → not Kharif. Kharif also: rice, maize, cotton, groundnut, jute. Zaid: muskmelon, watermelon, cucumber. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Chief food crop of India is –Rice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Chief food crop of India → Rice; Wheat is second. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is the most important food crop in terms of cropped area?Rice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest cropped area among food crops → Rice (51.27 million ha, 2024-25); Wheat 32.80 million ha. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is not a Variety of Rice?Jawala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Not a rice variety → Jawala. Rice varieties: Jaya, Padma, Hansa, Krishna, Jamuna, Kaveri, Annapurna, Ratna. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements and choose the correct code to answer –(A) is true but, (R) is false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Punjab → major rice exporter (A true) but not the top producer (R false). Variant then: West Bengal largest; 2024-25: Uttar Pradesh, Telangana, West Bengal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The states which account for more than halfofthe total rice production in India are –West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        More than half of India's rice → West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The correct sequence in decreasing order of the four sugarcane producing states in India is:U.P., Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Sugarcane producers when asked (descending): Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh; UP leads (also in 2024-25). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which States in India are the largest producers of sugarcane?Bihar and Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest sugarcane producers (among options) → Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. 2013 order: UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Haryana. 2024-25: UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat lead. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The first three leading producers of sugar in India are:U.P., Maharashtra, Karnataka

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Top three sugar producers when asked: UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka. Now (ISMA, 31 December 2025): Maharashtra first, UP second. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Yellow Revolution is related to –Production of Oilseeds

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yellow Revolution → oilseeds; Green → foodgrain; White → milk; Blue → fish. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following states is the leading producer of Soyabean?Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Leading soyabean producer (when asked) → Madhya Pradesh. 2024-25: Maharashtra 7.37, Madhya Pradesh 5.38, Rajasthan 1.18 million tonnes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ‘Varuna’ is a variety of –Mustard

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Varuna, Pusa Bold, Jaikisan → Mustard varieties. Must know
