                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which among the following products is not usually exported from India?Pulses

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Not usually exported → Pulses (India imports them despite big output, due to high consumption); wheat, rice, sugar are exported at times. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Malaviya Chamatkar is a variety of –Pigeon-Pea (Arhar)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Malaviya Chamatkar → Arhar (pigeon pea) variety; other Arhar varieties: Bahar, Amar, Azad, Malaviya Vikas, Paras. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following states was the largest producer of pulses in 2011-12?Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest pulses producer in 2011-12 → Madhya Pradesh (still first in 2024-25). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • More than three-fourths of India's production of raw silk comes from –Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Over three-fourths of raw silk (when asked) → Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh; now (2023-24) over 58.99%. Leading mulberry silk state → Karnataka. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following pairs is correctly matched :-Eri-silk – Assam

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Silk leaders (2023-24): Mulberry → Karnataka (44.15%); Tasar → Jharkhand (71.06%); Eri → Assam (56.56%); Muga → Assam (65.6%). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Assam holds Eri and Muga; Jharkhand Tasar; Karnataka Mulberry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which Indian state is the largest producer of Coffee?Karnataka

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest coffee producer → Karnataka 70.43%; Kerala 20.07%, Tamil Nadu 5.30% (2024-25). Main varieties: Arabica and Robusta. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The largest producer of rubber in India isKerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest rubber producer → Kerala (Ernakulam, Kottayam, Kozhikode, Kollam); India 6th in natural rubber production (FAO 2024). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which state is the largest producer of ‘Tobacco’ in India?Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Largest tobacco producers (2024-25): Gujarat > Andhra Pradesh > Uttar Pradesh > Karnataka. Among the options when asked, Uttar Pradesh was largest. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The state known as ‘garden of spices’ is –Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Kerala → 'Garden of Spices' / 'Spice Garden' of India. But the largest spice producer (2024-25, 3rd A.E.) is Madhya Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Kerala is the 'garden of spices'; Madhya Pradesh is the top spice producer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is Jhuming (also known as Paida) system?Cutting ofjungle and leaving it to dry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Jhuming (Paida) → shifting cultivation by tribes: cut the jungle, leave it to dry, then farm; shift to a new place when fertility falls. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Banana–Maharashtra was the wrong pair when asked.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • The state of India, which has the largest share in food grain production, is –Uttar Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest foodgrain producer (2024-25 final): Uttar Pradesh 17.85%; then Madhya Pradesh 13.04%, Punjab 9.16%.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • Which of the following crops is grown throughout the year?Maize

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Maize (corn) → can be grown throughout the year; versatile, widely adapted; called 'Queen of Cereals' globally.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • India’s rank in vegetable production is –Second

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Vegetables: India 2nd in the world after China (FAO 2024, other vegetables fresh n.e.c.). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following varieties has been developed as a result of a cross between Dasheri and of mango Neelam?Amrapali

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Amrapali mango = hybrid of Dasheri × Neelam, developed in 1971 by the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (Pusa), Delhi.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the codes given below:3 1 2 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest producers: Jute → West Bengal; Tea → Assam; Rubber → Kerala; Sugarcane → Uttar Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following States was declared in January 2016 to be the first organic State of India?Sikkim

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sikkim → India's first fully organic (bio) state, declared by PM Narendra Modi in January 2016.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • About one-third of India's cattle population is found in the three states, these are:—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          When asked: Madhya Pradesh, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh (b). Cattle 2019: West Bengal 19.1 million > Uttar Pradesh 19.0 > Madhya Pradesh 18.8. Book gives no single answer (*). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who is known as the father of India’s ‘White Revolution’?Dr. Varghese Kurien

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Dr. Verghese Kurien → Father of India's White Revolution (milk production), which made India the largest milk producer in the world. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The most mineralized rock system of India is –Dharwar System

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Dharwar system → India's most mineralised rock system and main source of metallic minerals: high-grade iron ore, manganese, copper, lead, gold. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In which rock system, out of the following, is iron-ore found in India?Dharwar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Iron ore in India → mainly in the Dharwar rock system, the most economically valuable rock system. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Iron mines: Gurumahisani → Odisha (Mayurbhanj); Bailadila → Chhattisgarh (Dantewada); Noamundi → Jharkhand (West Singhbhum); Kudremukh → Karnataka (Chikkamagaluru). Madhya Pradesh → largest copper ore producer. Key copper districts: Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan), Balaghat (MP), East Singhbhum (Jharkhand). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following Indian states is the biggest producer of Mica?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Mica producer: Andhra Pradesh when asked (a); Rajasthan is the biggest producer now (2021-22, IMYB 2022).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • Which one of the following states does not produce Mica?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Mica: Madhya Pradesh didn't produce it when asked (b). 2021-22: Rajasthan the only producer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • Which one of the following rock systems in India is the main source of coal deposits?Gondwana system

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Gondwana system → main source of India's coal: over 99% of deposits and production; mostly eastern and central peninsula, also Assam and Sikkim.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • Which one of the following states is the largest producer of coal in India?Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest coal producer (2024-25) → Odisha (about 25.71%), followed by Jharkhand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           • Which of the following is the largest coal producing state of India?Odisha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Largest coal-producing state (2024-25) → Odisha. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Three leading producers of coal in descending order are–Chhattisgarh, Odisha and Jharkhand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Coal output 2008-09: Chhattisgarh 20.7% > Odisha 20.0% > Jharkhand 19.5%. 2024-25: Odisha 25.71%, Jharkhand 19.68%, Chhattisgarh 19.56%, Madhya Pradesh 15.99%. Must know

Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In which of the following coal region the coal reserve is maximum?Raniganj

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              36 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Assertion (A): Ablack hole is an astronomical entity that cannot be seen by telescope.Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Black hole cannot be seen by telescope → its intense gravity (high density) lets no radiation, not even light, escape; A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who first propounded that the Sun is the center of our Solar system and the earth revolves around it?Copernicus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Copernicus (Poland) → first gave the Heliocentric Theory (Sun at centre, Earth revolves) in 'Commentariolus'; book notes Varahamihira gave the idea in the sixth century. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The number of the planet in the solar system is –9

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Old count 9 planets; order from Sun → Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune (then Pluto); Earth 149.6 million km from Sun. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid 'My Very Educated Mother Just Served Us Noodles' = Mercury to Neptune in order.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer by using the codes given below the lists:4 3 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Smallest planet → Pluto (old list; now Mercury); largest → Jupiter; second from Sun → Venus; nearest to Sun → Mercury. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Solar energy is due to –Nuclear Fusion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Solar energy → nuclear fusion: small nuclei (hydrogen) combine into heavier helium, releasing energy; fission splits a heavy nucleus. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The solar eclipse occurs on -New Moon day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Solar eclipse → only on New Moon day (Amavasya), when the Moon comes between Earth and Sun and its shadow falls on Earth. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Full Moon (Poornima) is the trap option; a solar eclipse needs a New Moon.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • One Astronomical unit is average distance –Between Earth and Sun

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1 Astronomical Unit (AU) → mean Earth–Sun distance, 149.6 million km (about 150 million km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The earth is nearest to the sun on –3rd January

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Perihelion (Earth nearest the Sun) → first week of January (about 3rd–4th January); Aphelion (farthest) → 4th July. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Perihelion = Proximity (near); Aphelion = Away (far).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The planet which is called twin sister of the earth is –Venus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Venus → Earth's twin sister (sister planet); also the brightest planet, Morning Star and Evening Star. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Time taken by light emitted from sun to reach earth is –8 minutes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 19 seconds to reach Earth; nearest option: 8 minutes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following planet is nearest to earth?Mars

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Nearest planet to Earth: Venus (41.4 million km), then Mars (78.4 million km); when Venus is not an option, answer Mars. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The duration of its day and tilt of its axis are almost identical to those of the Earth. This is true of:Mars

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Mars → day 24 h 37 min and axial tilt 25°12′, almost the same as Earth's (23 h 56 min; 23°30′). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which is the largest Planet in the Solar System?Jupiter

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Largest planet → Jupiter (diameter 142 984 km), then Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Earth, Venus, Mars; Mercury smallest (4 879 km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following planets is the farthest planet of the solar system –Some times Neptune and some times Pluto

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Pluto's elliptical orbit dips inside Neptune's, so Neptune was farthest 1979–1999, otherwise Pluto. Since Pluto became a dwarf planet (2006), Neptune is the farthest planet. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When does a Lunar eclipse take place?When the earth comes between the sun and the moon.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lunar eclipse → Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon; it happens only on a full moon day. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The ‘blue moon’ phenomenon occurs when –Two full moons occur in the same month.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Blue moon → two full moons in the same month; a full moon comes every 29.5 days, so an extra one builds up about every 2.7154 years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The group of small pieces of rock revolving round the sun between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter are called:Asteroids

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Asteroids → small rocky bodies orbiting the Sun between Mars and Jupiter (not Jupiter and Saturn); most are small, some up to 1000 km across. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Zero degree latitude and zero degree longitude lies in theAtlantic Ocean

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              0° latitude meets 0° longitude (Equator × Prime Meridian) → in the Gulf of Guinea, Atlantic Ocean. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The basis of deciding the standard time of any place is–Prime Meridian

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Standard time base → Prime Meridian (0°, Greenwich). It crosses UK, France, Spain, Algeria, Mali, Burkina-Faso, Togo, Ghana; not Niger, Nigeria or Portugal. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The local time of a place is 6:00 AM when the Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) is 3:00 AM, what is the longitude of the place?45° East

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Local time 6:00 AM when GMT is 3:00 AM → 3 hours ahead → 15 × 3 = 45° East. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid 1 hour = 15° of longitude; 1° = 4 minutes; east is ahead, west is behind.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Through which, one of the following groups of countries does the Equator pass?Colombia, Kenya and Indonesia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Equator's 13 countries: Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Gabon, both Congos, Sao Tome, Uganda, Kenya, Somalia, Maldives, Indonesia, Kiribati. Not: Mexico, Venezuela, Brunei, Rwanda, Equatorial Guinea. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't be misled by the name: the Equator does not pass through Equatorial Guinea.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Tropic of Capricorn does not pass through –Bolivia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Tropic of Capricorn crosses Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Chile, Namibia, Botswana, South Africa, Mozambique, Madagascar, Australia (also French Polynesia, Tonga); not Bolivia. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • On which date day and night are of equal duration?23 September

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Equal day and night → equinoxes: 20/21 March and 22/23 September, when the Sun is overhead at the Equator. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The shortest day of the year in Northern hemisphere is on –22 December

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Northern Hemisphere: shortest day 21/22 December (winter solstice), longest 20/21 June (summer solstice). Southern Hemisphere: the reverse, longest day 21/22 December. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • On which of the following dates your shadow at noon is the smallest?June 21

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Smallest noon shadow → 21 June (summer solstice), when the Sun is vertically overhead at the Tropic of Cancer. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following continents was not a part of Gondwana Land?North America

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Gondwana Land (southern part of Pangaea) → South America, Africa, Madagascar, Australia, Antarctica, Arabian Peninsula, Peninsular India; not North America. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Mauna Loa is an active volcano in –Hawaii

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Mauna Loa ('Long Mountain') → active volcano covering half of Hawaii Island, USA; first well-documented eruption in 1843. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following are active Volcanoes?2 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Active volcanoes → Etna (Sicily, Italy) and Vesuvius (near Naples). Kilimanjaro (Tanzania, Africa's highest peak) is dormant; Aconcagua is non-volcanic. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The most active Volcano is –Kilauea

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Most active volcano → Kilauea (Hawaii Island, USA); next Etna (Italy), then Piton de la Fournaise and Nyamuragira. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Richter Scale is used to measure –Intensity of earthquake

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Richter scale → measures earthquakes; strictly it gives magnitude, while intensity is on the Mercalli scale. The book accepts 'intensity of earthquake' as the closest option. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following continents has the largest number of countries?Africa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Most countries → Africa (54); then Europe 49, Asia 48, North America 23, Oceania 14, South America 12. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • As per area which of the following is the largest continent?Africa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Largest continent → Asia (44,568,500 sq km); among the options, Africa (30,065,000). Order: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following countries is not located in the continent of Africa?Guyana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Guyana → South America (capital George Town), not Africa; Gabon, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau are African. Area order: Africa > South America > Europe > Australia. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Guyana (South America) with Guinea or Guinea-Bissau (West Africa).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following presents the correct sequence (in descending order) of the area of the continents?Asia, Africa, North America, Europe

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Continents by area (descending): Asia, Africa, North America, … Europe, Australia. Smallest → Australia; two smallest → Australia and Europe. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Among the following, which one is not a young folded mountain?Sierra Nevada

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Not a young folded mountain → Sierra Nevada (block mountain, California, USA); Rocky, Himalaya, Alps are young folded. Andes → South America. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Three mountain ranges determining the boundary between India and Myanmar are –None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              India–Myanmar boundary → Arakan Yoma range (Himalayan extension in western Myanmar; hills Naga, Chin, Lushai, Patkoi). Khasi Hills (Meghalaya) are not on it, so 'None of the above'. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Must-know questions: 36
