                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                36 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Mountain range which is different from the others is–Appalachian

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Odd one out → Appalachian: old mountains of the Caledonian period. Alps, Andes, Himalayas (also Rocky, Atlas) are Tertiary (Alpine) folded mountains. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Drakensberg is a mountain of –South Africa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Drakensberg → range mainly in South Africa and Lesotho; highest peak Thabana Ntlenyana (3482 m, Lesotho). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Match List-I with List-II and choose the correct answer using the codes given below in the lists:3 1 4 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Spain–France → Pyrenees; Switzerland → Alps (highest Mont Blanc, about 4807 m); Bulgaria → Balkan; Italy → Apennine. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The average elevation of Tibetan Plateau above sea level is –5 Km

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tibetan (Qinghai-Tibetan) Plateau → average elevation over 4500 m (nearest option 5 km); area about 2.5 million sq km. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Death Valley is Known for its –Excessive Heat (Hotness)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Death Valley (California, USA) → known for excessive heat: hottest and most arid valley of the USA; lowest place in North America (–86 m). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Great Artesian Basin (GAB) is located in –Australia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Great Artesian Basin → Australia; one of the world's largest underground water reservoirs (about 1.7 million sq km), west of the Great Dividing Range. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The biggest desert in the world is:Sahara

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Biggest (non-polar) desert → Sahara, North Africa (about 3.6 million square miles). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Gibson - Brazil

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Wrong pair → Gibson – Brazil: Gibson Desert is in Western Australia. Correct: Sonoran – USA; Taklamakan – China; Karakum – Turkmenistan. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which country is the Gobi desert located?Mongolia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Gobi Desert → southern Mongolia and northern China; surrounded by the Alashan, Tienshan and Altai mountains. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following statements is not true regarding the Atacama?It lies in Southern Chile.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Atacama (South America) → driest place on Earth; rich in sodium nitrate and copper; lies in northern Chile and southern Peru, not southern Chile. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Atacama is in northern Chile, not southern Chile.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Kalahari Desert lies in1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Kalahari Desert (930000 sq km, interior Southern Africa) → mainly Botswana, parts of Namibia and South Africa. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Savannas are most widespread in –Africa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Savanna (grassland with shrubs, scattered trees, between rainforest and desert) → most widespread in East Africa; also Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela, southern India. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?Downs - Tropical grassland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Wrong pair → Downs – Tropical grassland: Downs are temperate. Tropical: Llanos, Campos, Savanna. Temperate: Prairies, Pampas, Steppes, Veld, Downs. Selva → tropical forest. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Savanna is a tropical grassland, not a temperate one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which one of the following countries are Pampas Grasslands located?Argentina

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pampas grasslands → mainly Argentina; some portions in Uruguay and Brazil. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following countries has the longest coastline?Canada

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Longest coastline → Canada (202,080 km); then Norway (83281 km), Indonesia (54,716 km), Greenland, Russia, Philippines. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of these countries forms the longest territorial border with India?Bangladesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Longest land border with India → Bangladesh (4096.7 km). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Israel has common borders with:Lebanon, Syria, Jordan and Egypt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Israel's land borders → Lebanon (north), Syria (north-east), Jordan (east), Egypt (south-west); Mediterranean Sea on the west. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ‘Horn of Africa’ consists of –Somalia, Ethiopia and Djibouti

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Horn of Africa (Somali Peninsula, East Africa) → Djibouti, Ethiopia, Eritrea, Somalia; not Sudan. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Afghanistan does not have a common border withRussia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Afghanistan's neighbours → Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan (north), China (north-east), India (south-east), Pakistan (east, south), Iran (west); not Russia. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following countries is not a land-locked country?Liberia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Not landlocked → Liberia. The world has 45 landlocked countries, e.g. Afghanistan, Laos, Luxembourg; Chad is a landlocked African country. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The only land-locked Country in Southeast Asia is-Laos

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Only landlocked country of Southeast Asia → Laos (borders Myanmar, China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following rivers forms international border?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Border rivers → Rio Grande (USA–Mexico, identified 1845) and Rhine (France–Germany). Two options fit, so the book gives no single answer (*). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 38th Parallel border lines divide which of the two following countries?North Korea and South Korea.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                38th parallel (38° N) → North Korea–South Korea. Oder-Neisse → Poland–Germany; Durand → Pakistan–Afghanistan; Radcliffe → India–Pakistan/Bangladesh; McMahon → India–China. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is not a national capital?Bonn; New York

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Not national capitals → Bonn (West Germany's capital before 1990; Germany's now Berlin) and New York (USA's is Washington D.C.); the book accepts both. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which is not correctly matched?Tasmania - Uganda

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tasmania → island state of Australia (across Bass Strait), not Uganda. Correct: Sicily → Italy; Newfoundland → Canada; Durban → South Africa. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which city of Turkey is known as the `Gateway to the West'?Istanbul

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Gateway to the West → Istanbul (Turkey), bounded by the Sea of Marmara, Bosporus Strait and Golden Horn. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which country is famous by the name of the land of the rising sun?Japan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Land of the Rising Sun → Japan ('Nippon' means land of the rising sun). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Datum line:Is a horizontal line to the sea level from where heights and depths are measured

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Datum line → horizontal line at sea level from which all heights and depths are measured. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Earth's water: 96.5% salt; 2.5% fresh, mostly in glaciers and polar ice (68.7%, not 95%); usable fresh water under 1%; next largest store is groundwater. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Sargasso Sea is a part of the-North Atlantic Ocean

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Sargasso Sea → part of the North Atlantic; marked by typical marine vegetation (sargassum seaweed). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Agulhas current flows in –The Indian Ocean

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Agulhas → warm (not cold) current of the South Indian Ocean; formed by Madagascar and Mozambique currents, later joins the West Wind Drift. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following statements is true?Ocean salinity is maximum at the Tropic of Cancer and Capricorn.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Ocean salinity peaks near the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn (low rain, high evaporation). Benguela is not Pacific; cold Humboldt (Peruvian) is not North Pacific. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The highest salinity is found in:Lake Van in Turkey

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Salinity per book: Lake Van (Turkey) 330‰ > Dead Sea 238‰ > Great Salt Lake 220‰ > Red Sea 36-41‰; when Van is absent, answer Dead Sea. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What are the causes of high-tide low tide formation in the oceans?Due to Gravitation, Centripetal force and the centrifugal force

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tides → Moon's gravitational pull plus centripetal and centrifugal forces; the indirect high tide (side away from the Moon) → Earth's centrifugal force. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which one of the following positions given in the figure sea-tide would have maximum height?M₄

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Highest tide (spring tide) → Sun, Earth and Moon in a straight line (syzygy) at full and new moon; perigean spring tide when the Moon is closest. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which is the world's deepest trench?Challenger

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                World's deepest trench → Mariana Trench (Pacific); its Challenger Deep, named after HMS Challenger, is the deepest point of the oceans. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following statements is correct?The elevation of Nuuk above the sea level is 3 meter

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Greenland → world's largest island, belongs to Denmark (not USA); Nuuk is its capital and largest city, 1-3 m above sea level.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   • Which of the following is the largest island of Japan?Honshu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In the vertical structure of the atmosphere, which one is the lowest layer?Troposphere

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The ozone layer lies in the:Stratosphere

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following layers of the atmosphere is responsible for the deflection of radio waves?Ionosphere

Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Wireless communication is reflected to the earth’s surface by –Ionosphere

Must know
