                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Revise: traps and look-alike facts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        88 look-alike facts that are easy to mix up.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Read each pair and say the difference in your own words.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 3 Don't pick 23°30' South; the line dividing India is 23°30' North. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 4 Don't pick Allahabad/Prayagraj: the meridian passes Mirzapur district nearby. The book gives no single answer (*). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 5 Indira Point (south, Great Nicobar) with the northernmost point near Siachen Glacier. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 6 Radcliffe (Pakistan) with Durand (Afghanistan) or McMahon (China). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 6 Radcliffe Line → Pakistan; Durand Line → Afghanistan; Indira Point is a place, not a line. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 8 Bhabar (pebble belt at foothills) with Tarai, Doon or Khadar. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 9 Don't place Kodaikanal in the Anaimalai; it is in the Palni Hills. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 10 If K2 is an option it is India's highest; Kanchenjunga wins only when K2 is missing. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 21 Bhotiya (UP, Uttarakhand) with Bhutiya (Sikkim, Tripura, West Bengal). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 21 Not a caste, tribe or wooden art. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 23 Jamuna (Brahmaputra in Bangladesh) with the Yamuna of India. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 23 It joins the Kali, not the Alaknanda. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 23 Don't swap them: Badrinath–Alaknanda, Kedarnath–Mandakini. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 23 Answer is Gomukh, not Gangotri or Tapovan. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 23 North Koel (Son, Ganga basin) with South Koel (joins Sankh). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 25 Not volcanic, wind or glacial origin. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 25 Rapti (Ghaghara tributary) with Tapti (west-flowing). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 25 Exam answer for 'Ganga of the South' here is Cauvery, not Godavari. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 27 Cuttack, not Bhubaneswar, stands on the Mahanadi. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 27 Hampi–Tungabhadra, not Malaprabha. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 28 Width: Jog; volume: Sivasamudram. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 28 Chilika = largest saltwater lagoon; Sambhar = largest inland salt lake. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 28 Konkan = Maharashtra's west coast; Malabar = Kerala's west coast. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 28 By volume Wular; by area Kolleru. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 28 It lies on the Rohtas Plateau but in Kaimur district, not Rohtas. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 30 Not the Garo, Naga or Mikir Hills. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 34 Laterite is NOT rich in lime. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 35 Reh, Thur, Chopan, Kallar are names of saline soils, not alluvial. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 35 Keys differ: this question accepts 'poor in phosphorus', while another in this chapter keys 'rich in phosphoric acid'. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 35 Bhangar = old alluvium; Khadar = new alluvium. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 37 Lime treats acidic soil; gypsum treats Usar (alkaline) soil. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 38 Terracing is a soil conservation method, not a cause of erosion. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 39 Dry deciduous is largest overall; moist deciduous is second and the answer only because dry was not an option. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 40 Dastur (Garland Canal) with Visvesvaraya or K.L. Rao (river interlinking proposals). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 46 Gobind Sagar (Himachal, Bhakra) with Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar (Sonebhadra, Uttar Pradesh). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 48 These dams are on the Barakar, not the Damodar main stream. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 50 20 agro-ecological zones with 15 agro-climatic regions. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 50 Mixed farming (crops + animals) with mixed cropping (two or more crops in one field). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 51 Borlaug worked in Mexico but was from the USA. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 51 Pisciculture (fish) with Sericulture, Floriculture or Horticulture. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 52 Recent data puts Madhya Pradesh second; Uttar Pradesh stays first. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 59 Swap trap: Chikmagalur = coffee, Mandya = sugar. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 60 Tea Board comes under the Commerce Ministry, not the Agriculture Ministry; its HQ is Kolkata, not Bengaluru. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 61 Kerala is the 'garden of spices'; Madhya Pradesh is the top spice producer. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 63 Yellow Revolution is about oilseeds, not jute. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 63 Maize is C4, while rice and wheat are C3. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 66 Bailadila ore is haematite; magnetite has more iron and is found mainly in Karnataka. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 74 Singrauli (Son valley) with Singareni (Godavari valley). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 82 Don't go by the name: 'Madras' Aluminium is at Mettur (Salem), not in Chennai. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 83 Elsewhere the book names Ranipet (Tamil Nadu) as India's first fertilizer unit; here it calls Sindri the first plant. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 84 With Anand (Gujarat), home of the National Dairy Development Board, not NDRI. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 87 Ennore Port and Kamarajar Port are the same port, not two. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 88 Don't mix up with Tirupati's Venkateswara temple, which is in the Seshachalam range of Andhra Pradesh. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 90 Don't be fooled by 'star' in Brittle Star; it is a sea creature. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 92 Full Moon (Poornima) is the trap option; a solar eclipse needs a New Moon. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 94 Don't pick Mercury just because it is nearest the Sun; Venus is the hottest planet. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 100 The Moon's rotation and revolution both take 27 days 7 hours 43 minutes; 23½ days is wrong. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 101 Comets are not found mostly between Venus and Mercury; that statement (2) is false. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 103 Don't assume New York lies north of Rome; Rome's latitude is higher. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 105 Don't be misled by the name: the Equator does not pass through Equatorial Guinea. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 112 Magma is inside the Earth; the same material is called lava once it comes out. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 113 Mercalli scale measures intensity; Richter scale measures magnitude. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 113 Focus is the underground origin; epicentre is the surface point above it. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 114 Guyana (South America) with Guinea or Guinea-Bissau (West Africa). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 115 With orogenic forces, which build mountains by folding. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 118 Atacama is in northern Chile, not southern Chile. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 119 Savanna is a tropical grassland, not a temperate one. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 120 Great Britain is not the United Kingdom: Northern Ireland is only in the UK. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 125 Slovenia (Ljubljana) with Slovakia (Bratislava). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 134 Largest (Amazon, by basin and volume) with longest (Nile). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 136 Mississippi = bird's foot delta; Nile = arcuate delta. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 145 With the Saffir-Simpson scale, which rates hurricanes. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 151 Rich vegetation with rich soil. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 152 Westerlies explain the mild temperature and good rain of Western Europe, not the ice-free ports. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 152 Don't pick Cherrapunji here; in this question the answer is Mawsynram. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 152 La Nina does affect the monsoon: it activates it, while El Nino harms it. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 152 El Nino lowers plankton, not raises it. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 154 Heidelberg and Neanderthal humans are older. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 154 Kayak is the narrow hunting boat; Umiak is the bigger transport boat. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 156 Now (FAO 2024) USA leads sorghum (jowar), then Nigeria and India. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 156 Kenya leads tea exports by quantity, China by value. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 156 Olericulture (vegetables) with pomology (fruits). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 158 Don't mix interior order (iron, nickel) with crust order (aluminium, iron). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 161 Horn silver, ruby silver and lunar caustic do contain silver. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 164 Reserves leader is Venezuela; production leader is USA. question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 164 Sumed carries crude oil only, not natural gas; the book notes (d) is possible literally, but takes (a). question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ch 170 Isohyet (rain) with isohaline (salinity). question
